XPLORIO.TITLE: Xplorio
XPLORIO.OPEN_DOC: Xplorio runs on its own port: {url}
XPLORIO.SECTION_SETTINGS_DOC: Further settings (language, theme, Rotel amplifier and more) are in /data/xplorio/config.local.js on the player, see the setup guide.
XPLORIO.PORT_DOC: Port of the Xplorio web server (default 4040). Bookmarks and home screen icons use this address.
XPLORIO.TAG_SERVICE_DOC: Needed for the tag editor, library check, history, discovery and mood mix.
XPLORIO.ROTEL_BRIDGE_DOC: Control of a Rotel amplifier over the network (address as ROTEL_HOST in config.local.js).
XPLORIO.BAD_PORT: Please enter a port between 1024 and 65535 (not 3000).
XPLORIO.SYSTEMD: {name} runs as a system service (systemd), the plugin leaves it as it is.
XPLORIO.PORT_BUSY: Port {port} is in use: the Xplorio web server could not start.
XPLORIO.LASTFM_KEY_DOC: From https://www.last.fm/api/accounts. For similar artists, texts, cover search and mood tags. Stays on the player (/data/xplorio/data/keys.json), never shown again; leave empty to keep the saved one.
XPLORIO.LASTFM_SECRET_DOC: Only needed for scrobbling. Leave empty to keep the saved one.
XPLORIO.LASTFM_CLEAR_DOC: Removes key and secret from the player when saving.
XPLORIO.LASTFM_BAD: The Last.fm key or secret contains invalid characters (only letters and digits).
XPLORIO.LASTFM_FAIL: The Last.fm access could not be saved: {error}
